title: Full circle: a two-line greeting
idea: First full micro-circle on a fresh task: understand, example, code, check — all in one lesson.

exercises.prompt: TASK: Show a two-line greeting — Welcome, then Enjoy. What is the output?
options: Welcome on one line, Enjoy on the next
exercises.explanation: Understand first: two lines, Welcome then Enjoy. That's what we must produce.

exercises.prompt: Example step: write the expected output by hand. It is:
exercises.explanation: Exactly two lines in the right case and order. This is the target to check against.

exercises.prompt: We wrote the example before writing any code.
exercises.explanation: Example first, always — so the code has a target and the check has something to compare to.

exercises.prompt: Code step: arrange the prints to match the example.
exercises.explanation: Welcome first, Enjoy second — same order as the example.

exercises.prompt: Build the second line that shows Enjoy.
exercises.explanation: print("Enjoy") — word in quotes, inside brackets.

options: Welcome, then Enjoy on two lines
exercises.explanation: Two prints, two lines, in order: Welcome then Enjoy.

exercises.prompt: Check step: output is Welcome then Enjoy. Example was Welcome then Enjoy. Result?
exercises.explanation: Match! It passes. You ran the whole circle: understand, example, code, check.

exercises.prompt: Put the four micro-circle steps in order.
exercises.explanation: Understand, example, code, check — the full micro-circle.

exercises.prompt: Suppose the code had been Enjoy then Welcome. What would the check say?
options: Fail — order doesn't match the example
exercises.explanation: Same words, wrong order fails the check. The example keeps you honest about order.

exercises.prompt: You just solved a whole small task by running understand -> example -> code -> check.
exercises.explanation: That's the first full micro-circle. The same rhythm scales up to bigger problems later.
